english.note: This is the all-purpose choice when “shaky” means unsteady or unsafe, and when it means unsound or unreliable.

exampleSentences.english: This table leg is shaky and really unsafe.
exampleSentences.traditional: 呢張枱腳郁郁吓，真係唔穩陣。

english.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for an object that is unsafe, poorly built, or not secure.

exampleSentences.english: The table is rickety because its legs are so short.
exampleSentences.traditional: 張枱腳咁短，成張枱都唔穩陣。
